يستحقروا (form X)
# يَسْتَحْقِرُوا (yastaḥqirū) /jas.taħ.qi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# يُسْتَحْقَرُوا (yustaḥqarū) /jus.taħ.qa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
